title: Do you have any outside income?
content: "Do you have any outside income?" This might be a job interview question, or it could be a question when you are talking to a creditor. In either case, you can simply reply with a yes or no. If it is a yes, then briefly tell them the other source of income. "I get paid child support from my ex-husband." "I have a rental property." "No. I do not."

examples.sentence: Do you have any outside income?
I get paid child support from my ex-husband.
